description: Bicycle Counts DLR is a dataset listed in Ireland national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Dún Laoghaire-Rathdown County Council. Bicycle traffic volumes from cycle counters in Dún Laoghaire-Rathdown County Council administrative area. Bicycle counter data is available from sixteen locations throughout the county. Ten of these locations record bidirectional traffic, with the remaining six recording unidirectional cycle traffic. Data is provided in hourly intervals (i.e. Coverage: Dún Laoghaire-Rathdown County Council. The portal files it under the publisher Dún Laoghaire-Rathdown County Council. Its tags are DLR, DLRCC, Dun Laoghaire-Rathdown, Transport and Infrastructure, bicycle. It offers 19 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON. The portal shows 2026-09-22 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ie-portal.
